claimDispositions.reason: TSS matrix confirms enterprise contract for Faculty/Staff on public data only; not general student license.
TSS matrix confirms paid faculty/staff service with no trial; not blanket student entitlement.
TSS matrix confirms Google Gemini Basic available for faculty, staff, and students under Policy 808.
TSS matrix confirms Google Gemini Pro is a limited license for faculty/staff only.
TSS matrix confirms Grammarly available for faculty, staff, and students under Policy 808 (not HIPAA).
TSS matrix confirms Microsoft Copilot (Rice) available for faculty and staff under Policy 808.
TSS matrix confirms Google NotebookLM available for faculty, staff, and students under Policy 808.
TSS matrix confirms Google NotebookLM Plus is a limited license for faculty/staff only.
Honor Council General AI Policy specifies course-specific instructor policies supersede general rules.
TSS prohibits using Policy 808 sensitive/confidential data with public consumer AI services.
Student FAQs state AI tools like ChatGPT or Grammarly are allowed only with explicit instructor permission.
Provost urges faculty to outline course stance on AI in syllabus to foster transparency.
Faculty/staff tool usage must adhere to Rice AI Usage Guidelines and tool documentation.

gaps: Rice TSS lists student access for Gemini Basic, NotebookLM, and Grammarly, but restricts Copilot, Gemini Pro, and Firefly to faculty/staff; student standalone costs remain unverified.
The Honor Council general AI policy applies across undergraduate assessments unless superseded by course syllabus rules; universal per-exam permissions remain unverified.
Policy 808 protects sensitive data but HIPAA-protected healthcare data is excluded from all cloud tools; research project-specific AI clearances remain an unverified gap.
Formal faculty investigation workflows and committee sanction outcome schedules under Graduate Honor Council procedures are not fully evidenced by the 30-day appeal filing excerpt.

title.zh: 依各课程大纲指引使用并遵循TSS数据分类规范

scope.en: Rice University baseline: Course syllabi govern AI permissions; tool access does not confer exam rights; Policy 808 advises sensitive records should not be used with public AI, while HIPAA data requires prior ISO consultation; under Graduate Honor Council procedures, students found in violation may appeal within 30 calendar days of notice.
scope.zh: 莱斯大学政策基准：课程大纲决定AI使用权限；校内工具账号不代表考评许可；Policy 808建议敏感数据不宜使用公共AI，涉及HIPAA数据须事先咨询ISO；研究生荣誉委员会程序下，被认定违规的研究生可在收到通知后30个日历日内申诉。

do.en: Check syllabus and confirm instructor stance.
do.zh: 查阅大纲并向教师确认AI使用立场。

do.en: Disclose tools used following course rules.
do.zh: 遵循课程规则如实披露所用工具。

dont.en: Sensitive Policy 808 records should not be used with public AI; consult ISO for HIPAA.
dont.zh: Policy 808敏感数据不宜使用公共AI；涉及HIPAA须先咨询ISO。

dont.en: Do not assume campus tool access equals exam clearance.
dont.zh: 切勿将校园账号权限视作考场许可。

scope.en: Rice University baseline: Course syllabi govern AI permissions; tool access does not confer exam rights; Policy 808 advises sensitive records should not be used with public AI, while HIPAA data requires prior ISO consultation; under Graduate Honor Council procedures, students found in violation may appeal within 30 calendar days of notice.
scope.zh: 莱斯大学政策基准：课程大纲决定AI使用权限；校内工具账号不代表考评许可；Policy 808建议敏感数据不宜使用公共AI，涉及HIPAA数据须事先咨询ISO；研究生荣誉委员会程序下，被认定违规的研究生可在收到通知后30个日历日内申诉。

coursework.en: Rice student FAQs state generative AI is permitted only when explicitly authorized by course instructors; permissions vary by syllabus and assignment.
coursework.zh: 莱斯大学学生FAQ明确规定，生成式AI仅在主讲教师明确允许时方可用于课业；具体权限因课程大纲与作业要求而异。
coursework.meaningEn: Undergraduate and graduate coursework and assignments
coursework.meaningZh: 所有本科与研究生课程作业

exams.en: The Honor Council general AI policy applies across academic work, but individual course policies established by professors explicitly supersede general rules.
exams.zh: 荣誉法庭通用AI政策统领学术考核，但教授在课程大纲中设立的专属规则优先于法庭通用政策。
exams.meaningEn: Course examinations, quizzes, and formal assessments
exams.meaningZh: 课程期中期末考试、测验与考核

disclosure.en: Provost guidance urges faculty to define transparent AI expectations in syllabi, and CTE recommends disclosing AI assistance and providing citations.
disclosure.zh: 教务长指导意见敦促教师在教学大纲中明确AI立场，CTE建议学生披露AI协助并规范标引工具。
disclosure.meaningZh: 课业论文、书面报告与课堂展示

privacy_data.en: TSS guidelines advise that sensitive or confidential records under Policy 808 should not be used with consumer-focused or publicly available AI services; HIPAA data requires prior consultation with ISO.
privacy_data.zh: TSS指引建议受Policy 808约束的敏感或机密信息不宜使用消费级或公共AI服务；涉及HIPAA数据须事先咨询信息安全办公室（ISO）。
privacy_data.meaningEn: Student records, Policy 808 data, and university information
privacy_data.meaningZh: 学生档案、Policy 808机密数据与大学信息

approved_tools.en: The retained TSS matrix excerpt names Google Gemini Basic; it does not establish current access or terms.
approved_tools.zh: 保留的TSS服务矩阵摘录列出Google Gemini Basic；该摘录未确立现行资格或条款。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Campus enterprise agreements and software catalog
approved_tools.meaningZh: 校园企业协议工具与软件采购目录

research_publication.en: Responsible AI guidance requires that use of AI tools in research must follow Rice's AI Usage Guidelines and tool-specific support documentation.
research_publication.zh: 负责任AI指引要求在学术研究中使用AI工具必须遵守莱斯大学AI使用指引以及具体工具的支持文档。
research_publication.meaningEn: Scholarly publications, sponsored research, and datasets
research_publication.meaningZh: 学术研究成果、资助项目与科研数据集

academic_integrity.en: Under Graduate Honor Council procedures, students found in violation may appeal within 30 calendar days of notice.
academic_integrity.zh: 研究生荣誉委员会程序下，被认定违规的研究生可在收到通知后30个日历日内申诉。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Graduate Honor Council misconduct appeal filing timeline
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 研究生荣誉委员会学术不端裁决申诉时限

teaching_guidance.en: Faculty are encouraged to establish discipline-specific guidelines, set clear syllabus expectations, and consider fairness and learning impacts.
teaching_guidance.zh: 鼓励教师制定学科专项指引，在大纲中载明明确预期，并全面考量AI对教学公平性与培养成效的影响。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Syllabus policies and course curriculum design
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 教学大纲设计与课程方案制定

security_procurement.en: TSS guidance says to contact the Information Security Office before licensing new services, including generative AI services.
security_procurement.zh: TSS指引要求在许可新服务（包括生成式AI服务）前联系信息安全办公室。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Enterprise software licenses and third-party AI contracts
security_procurement.meaningZh: 校级企业软件采购与第三方AI合同

do.en: Check each course syllabus and obtain explicit instructor permission before using generative AI for coursework.
do.zh: 查阅各门课程大纲并在课业中使用生成式AI前取得主讲教师的明确许可。

do.en: Disclose AI tool usage whenever required by course syllabus guidelines or instructor instructions.
do.zh: 在课程大纲或任课教师有明确要求时，如实说明所使用的AI工具与生成内容。

dont.en: Do not infer coursework or examination authorization from institutional tool licensing or TSS availability tables.
dont.zh: 切勿从机构工具许可或TSS服务可用性列表中推导课程作业或考试的使用授权。

dont.en: Avoid inputting Policy 808 sensitive or confidential records into public AI services as advised by TSS guidelines; consult ISO prior to any use of HIPAA data.
dont.zh: 遵循TSS指引建议切勿向公共AI服务输入Policy 808敏感或机密信息；涉及HIPAA数据须事先咨询信息安全办公室（ISO）。

cl-rice-university-adobe-firefly-445.text: Adobe Firefly is listed for Rice University in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutionally licensed or procured.

evidence.quote: Rice TSS lists Adobe Firefly as Enterprise, with a current Rice contract as part of Creative Cloud, and access for Faculty and Staff.

claim-rice-honor-ai-plagiarism.text: Rice Honor Council's AI policy page says using AI software to generate ideas and passing them off as one's own is plagiarism; it also says course-specific AI policies may supersede the Honor Council's general AI policy.

evidence.quote: "Utilizing AI software to generate ideas and pass them off as one's own will also be considered plagiarism and will be adjudicated as such." This policy was voted on and ratified as of 2023. While this policy governs all academic work, professors are allowed to create their own course-specific AI policies.
evidence.location: The Rice Honor Council's General AI Policy

claim-rice-tss-private-info-public-ai.text: Rice Technology Solutions and Services AI Usage Guidelines say sensitive or confidential information covered by University Policy 808 should not be used with consumer-focused or publicly available AI services, and generative AI services should be reviewed by the Information Security Office before licensing.

evidence.quote: Information considered sensitive or confidential by University Policy 808 ( https://policy.rice.edu/808 ), including private information about individuals and protected research data, should not be used with consumer-focused or publicly available AI services. Before licensing new services, including Generative AI services, contact the Information Security Office.
evidence.location: Security and Privacy Considerations

claim-rice-student-ai-coursework-permiss.text: Rice University's Responsible AI student guidance says use of AI tools for coursework is allowed only when the instructor explicitly permits it, and students should check the syllabus or ask the professor before using AI on assignments.

evidence.quote: Use of AI tools like ChatGPT, Grammarly, or image generators is only allowed if your instructor explicitly says so. Each course may have different rules. Always check the syllabus or ask your professor before using AI to help with assignments.
evidence.location: FAQs: For Students

claim-rice-provost-syllabus-citation-gui.text: Rice Office of the Provost guidance urges faculty to include a syllabus section stating their course stance on AI use and the extent of allowed use; it also notes Honor Council guidance that LLM use must be cited.

evidence.quote: To foster transparency and manage expectations, we urge you to include a section in your syllabus outlining your stance on AI usage in your course. This can cover whether students are permitted to use such tools for assignments and the extent of their allowed use. Also, please note that the honor council guidance notes that the use of an LLM (referred to broadly in the undergraduate honor council update as AI) must be cited.
evidence.location: Inclusion in Your Course Syllabus

claim-rice-supported-ai-tools-follow-gui.text: Rice University's Responsible AI faculty and staff guidance says the university provides access to Grammarly, Zoom AI Companion, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, and NotebookLM, and use of those tools must follow Rice's AI Usage Guidelines and tool-specific support documentation.

evidence.quote: The university provides access to tools like Grammarly, Zoom: AI Companion, Microsoft Copilot (formerly Bing Chat Enterprise), Gemini, and NotebookLM. Use must follow Rice's AI Usage Guidelines and tool-specific support documentation.
evidence.location: FAQs: For Faculty & Staff
